only_treatment_variable: the selector that turns a working set into the six-record packet
question: Given a working set in which the required bridge and terminal evidence are ALREADY present, why does S2 select the wrong six records?
why_now: G2-v4E's grammar_v4 removed the availability bottleneck strongly enough to expose the next one. At cal_3000/M50, bridge working-set survival is 1.000 while P(bridge selected | in working set) is 0.015; terminal survival 0.747 with retention 0.268. Bridge acquisition therefore comes OFF the critical path -- the evidence is reaching the working set and dying in selection.
